title: La stangetta (Gaspar)
desc: Gaspar van Weerbeke, attributed to Isaac, La stangetta. 3 voices (Superius, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Gas0506), edited by Paul Kolb (Gaspar van Weerbeke: Collected Works. V. Settings of Liturgical Texts, Songs, and Instrumental Works, 2020); encoded by Karina Zybina. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
